transport.recipe: C7 3-rank merged-vNIC (launch_clean.sh, ALLPEER3 28.4us/op era) via PyNccl, grouped send/recv, one CUDA graph per step
transport.verdict: Gate A target 60us/layer at R=6 NOT met by NCCL (69.4us serialized eager). CUDA-graph replay costs ~250us fixed here, so graphs are not usable for this exchange as captured. Raw verbs measured 14.8us one-way for 120KB => custom RDMA-write path (~35-40us serialized round trip) is the transport.
